task: probe-sign-of-mean (development seam-validation; not a physiological classifier)

config.note: Probe consumes the raw prepared window with no filtering, resampling or segmentation.

provenance.trainingDataset: Not trained - synthetic deterministic probe, no data involved
provenance.methodology: One-layer deterministic graph (opset 13): output logits = [+sum, -sum] of the float32 input window; softmax argmax is the sign of the window mean. Built by onnx 1.22.0 via generate-probe-model.py; purpose is to exercise the ONNX Runtime Web seam end-to-end (Signal -> ModelInput -> session -> interpret). It is a test oracle, not a scientific model.
provenance.limitations: Development seam-validation probe only. Has no physiological or clinical meaning and must never be used to inform any medical or scientific conclusion.
